title: DEMO: Patient fall prevention review
description: Sample scenario for testing patient fall lessons.
lessons_learned: After a patient fall or near-fall, assess the patient promptly, document contributing factors, update fall precautions, and communicate the plan during handoff.

title: DEMO: Medication administration double check
description: Sample scenario for testing medication safety lessons.
lessons_learned: For medication safety, verify two patient identifiers and the medication against the order before administration; report near misses promptly.

title: DEMO: Billing account mismatch
description: Sample scenario for testing billing error lessons.
lessons_learned: To prevent billing errors, verify the patient account, service date, and insurance details against the source record before submitting a charge; escalate mismatches to the billing supervisor.

title: DEMO: Patient identification check
description: Sample scenario for testing patient identification lessons.
lessons_learned: For accurate patient identification, use two approved identifiers before medication, specimen collection, or a procedure, and stop to resolve any mismatch.

title: DEMO: Specimen label correction
description: Sample scenario for testing specimen labeling lessons.
lessons_learned: Prevent specimen labeling errors by labeling each sample at the patient's side immediately after collection and matching the label to two patient identifiers.

title: DEMO: Infection prevention hand hygiene
description: Sample scenario for testing infection control lessons.
lessons_learned: Consistent hand hygiene before and after patient contact, correct use of personal protective equipment, and clear isolation signage help prevent healthcare-associated infections.

title: DEMO: Equipment maintenance follow-up
description: Sample scenario for testing equipment failure lessons.
lessons_learned: When medical equipment fails, label it out of service, notify the equipment team, record the fault centrally, and verify preventive maintenance before returning it to use.

title: DEMO: Delayed escalation communication
description: Sample scenario for testing communication and escalation lessons.
lessons_learned: Use a clear escalation pathway and closed-loop communication so urgent patient concerns reach the responsible clinician promptly and the receiver confirms the action.

title: DEMO: Patient billing reconciliation
description: Sample scenario for testing invoice reconciliation lessons.
lessons_learned: A regular billing reconciliation between service records and invoices can catch duplicate charges, missing items, and account errors before statements are sent.

title: DEMO: Workplace onboarding policy briefing
description: Sample scenario for testing staff training lessons.
lessons_learned: Include a refresher on workplace conduct, incident reporting, and escalation contacts in staff onboarding, then confirm that staff know where to find the policies.

title: DEMO: Patient privacy reminder
description: Sample scenario for testing privacy and confidentiality lessons.
lessons_learned: Protect patient privacy by discussing clinical information only in appropriate areas, checking recipient details before sharing records, and reporting suspected confidentiality breaches promptly.

title: DEMO: Hazardous spill response
description: Sample scenario for testing environmental safety lessons.
lessons_learned: For a hazardous spill, secure the area, follow the correct cleanup procedure with suitable protective equipment, and report the hazard so the underlying cause can be addressed.
